units.name: Soldier
units.description: Soldiers are all-round solid fighters, and they can capture or repair villages to give you benefits.
units.guide: Soldiers are very useful in the early game, they can capture or repair villages to give you advantage. Although soldiers are not very powerful fighters, they can deal some decent damages to enemies with low physical defence.

units.name: Archer
units.description: With their powerful bows archers can attack from a distance and are especially efficient against airborne enemies.
units.guide: Archers start with quite low attack power, but due to their long attack range you can level them up more easily then soldiers. As they level up their attack will be more powerful. Meanwhile archers are also good at destroying air forces.

units.name: Aqua Elemental
units.description: Water elementals are friends of the water. When in water, they become much more stronger.
units.guide: Water elementals can move and fight much more efficiently in the water, so if you are planning to pick up a fight in places covered by water element is a good choice.

units.name: Sorceress
units.description: They are skilled in the use of necromancy. Sorceresses are weak in melee combat but they can summon skeletons from the dead to aid you in the battle.
units.guide: Sorceresses can summon skeletons from fallen units, so if the battle goes intense and many units die it's a good idea to recruit sorceresses. But since sorceresses are weak against physical melee attacks you should move them smartly.

units.name: Spirit
units.description: These mystical beings of pure light have an aura that can remove negative effects from your allies and heal them a little bit.
units.guide: The refresh aura of spirits can remove negative effects from allies nearby as well as heal them a bit, which means spirits are really good against wolves and skeletons. Note that spirits can fight better in forest but are weak against archers.

units.name: Wolf
units.description: Wolves are fearsome hunters with very high motility. They travel very fast on land and kill enemies with their poisonous bites.
units.guide: Wolves have deadly physical attacks and can move swiftly on land, so you can use them to destroy enemy key units quickly. But since wolves cannot receive terrain heal you should consider recruiting some healers.

units.name: Golem
units.description: Golems are ancient beings, incredibly strong in physical defence and are even stronger when in the mountains.
units.guide: Golems have very high physical defence and become even tougher when in mountains so they are good at defending enemies' physical attacks. However golems have relatively low magic defence so keep them away from enemy magic users.

units.name: Catapult
units.description: Catapults blaze a trail of destruction with their enormous attack range. However they have very low motility.
units.guide: Catapults have the longest attack range of all units so you can use them to destroy enemy back lines. Also you can use catapults to destroy villages. But since catapults have little defence against melee attacks and cannot attack once moved so you have to protect them properly.

units.name: Dragon
units.description: These massive flying beasts have ruled the sky since ancient times. They have very high motility and deadly melee attacks.
units.guide: Dragons are powerful air forces, they can move through all terrains easily and destroy enemies with their deadly attacks. Note that dragons' melee attacks can be even more deadly so make sure to put that in good use.

units.name: Commander
units.description: Commander is the heart of an army. He has quite strong battle skills and can capture enemy castles.
units.guide: Commanders can capture enemy castles which is the key to victory. But since you cannot do that at the beginning and commander's recruiting price increases every time they die, you will want to protect him and level him up as much as you can.

units.name: Skeleton
units.description: Skeletons are undead beings summoned by necromancers. They are not very strong but have poisonous attacks.
units.guide: Skeletons have very low attack power which means they are not good at dealing instant damages. But it's always a good idea trying to use skeletons to apply poison status to enemy key units.

units.name: Paladin
units.description: Paladins are holy armies who are skilled at healing and can also capture villages like soldiers do.
units.guide: Note that paladins' heal can exceed allies' max HP so you can use them to increase the attack power of your allies. Also paladins' heal can become holy damage to skeletons so you can use them to kill skeletons and avoid being poisoned.

units.name: Berserker
units.description: Berserkers are born fighters. The more enemies are around them the stronger they become.
units.guide: Since the more enemies are around the more attack power and physical defence berserkers gain, so when you are outnumbered try to recruit some berserkers. Also berserkers' attack aura can make your allies stronger and avoid negative affects.

units.name: Ghost
units.description: Ghosts are mystical undead beings. They float above the ground and can blind enemies with their attacks.
units.guide: Since ghosts are undead beings they are not afraid of poisons. And since ghosts can blind enemies it's always a good idea try to use them to attack enemy units with high attack damage.

units.name: Black Mage
units.description: Black mages are skilled at using dark magic. Their attacks are always powerful against those with low magic defence.
units.guide: Black mages have no abilities but they have quite high magic attack which makes them good magic damage dealers. However black mages are not that good at melee combat so try to use them wisely.

units.name: Wolfarcher
units.description: Wolfarchers are high mobility version of archers. They can strike almost anywhere you want them to attack.
units.guide: Due to their long attack range and high mobility, you can use wolfarchers to destroy enemy air forces quite easily no matter they are in back line or front line. And with their ability to blind targets they are also good at silencing enemy high attack units.

units.name: Ice Elemental
units.description: Ice elementals are mystical beings formed by pure ice. It seems they can fight well both in water and on land.
units.guide: Ice elementals have quite long attack range and have rehabilitation ability which means they will be very strong on the water. But even on land they are still good magic damage dealers.

units.name: Slime
units.description: Mystic creatures. It seems their soft body can absorb a lot of damages.
units.guide: Slimes are best against ranged attacks, but they are weak in melee battle so try to use them wisely.
